title: Bae Research Group
text: Search this site Embedded Files Bae Research Group Soft Active Materials Lab CAU & UC San Diego Join our team! We are looking for highly motivated postdoctoral, graduate, and undergraduate researchers. Prospective graduate students should apply to the Department of Chemical Engineering at Chung-Ang University. If you are interested, please send a CV and research interests to Prof. Jinhye Bae ( jbae@cau.ac.kr ). Welcome The aim of our research is to understand the deformation and assembly of soft matter on the nano to macro-scales, and integrate their unique characteristics into new approaches for applications in biomedical devices, soft robotics, actuators, and sensors. To learn more, please check the "Research" or “Publications” links, or contact us. Report abuse Report abuse
